description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-s2ei's change (3ae56002), which adds `atelier merge --sync` to merge the base into the branch, rerun current receipts and report whether the approval survived. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 7, atelier-3xq4): a rerun receipt's summary nests the old receipt's whole body, since the field it reads holds the body, not the Summary section. The reviewer of atelier-al1y, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
